data.name: Dragon Battle Princess
data.detailed_description:
Adult Content Description

  • Developer's Warning

Mild wound, bloodstain art

There are descriptions of some sexual harassment and criminal incidents

A small amount of vulgar and vulgar language performances, such as cursing and profanity.


About the Game

  • This game focuses heavily on story and leans toward the visual novel genre, while also incorporating action (ACT) gameplay elements in battle segments. Players can participate in combat alongside the protagonist, journeying into the world of this princess. ﻿The game also features a costume-changing system and numerous Easter eggs to enrich the story’s atmosphere.

  • The game is updated in chapter format, with each chapter updated once, similar to a comic book. You can decide whether to follow up on the future development progress of the game based on your experience, which is beneficial for both us and players, without worrying about losses.

Currently, the characters appearing in the game are as follows:

  • Protagonist

This princess longs for a beautiful youth and a hopeful future. However, the war changed everything, including her.

  • Princess’s Younger Sister

Yaer’s little sister. She was still an infant during the war eight years ago and cannot yet comprehend the events of this world. She doesn’t understand why everyone wears worried expressions, why people come and go so hurriedly, why her father forbids her from going outside, or why her mother hasn’t returned.

  • Princess’s Father

The current leader of the Dragon Clan. He fought in the war eight years ago and carries deep guilt over their defeat. What kind of man is he behind the scenes? His heart is filled with torment and anguish, desperate to break free from fate. He has fought for his people all his life, but in the end...

  • Dragon Clan’s Guard Captain

This man was betrayed in his youth and nearly killed. Homeless and at his wit’s end, he wandered to a riverside, overwhelmed with despair and ready to end his life. At that moment, he encountered the Dragon Clan’s leader — Yael’s father — who was fighting nearby. His fate changed completely. He spent many years in the military camp, growing close to Yael’s father, considering him like a brother.After the upheaval of war, he succeeded as the captain of the Dragon Knights. When the clan was nearly destroyed, and he saw the brother who had once fought by his side now utterly broken, he was overwhelmed with profound sorrow. For that man, for him, and for everything around them — what decision will he make...?

  • Dragon Clan Secretary

A strategist who advises the leader and has long served him with loyalty. After the war eight years ago, the Dragon Queen went missing, and he took on the responsibility of caring for the two princesses. By day, he works to restore the power of the Dragon Clan; by night, he teaches the princesses. The words he hears most often are: “When will Mom come back...?”

  • A Villager from the Elf Village

An elf girl with a slightly different appearance. One day, she was caught in danger during an otherwise ordinary moment. Yael happened to pass by and saved her life. That’s how they met. She is curious and kind, but never speaks about her past. It seems she knows something about the war — and the demons...

  • Two Children from the Elf Village

War orphans found and raised by the current village chief from the ruins. They are afraid of the worsening environment around them. Yael’s arrival gives them hope that the world might be saved.

Do you want to learn about the story of a Dragon Clan girl from another world? Follow Dragon Battle Princess for future updates!

  • Game Features

Extensive and Rich Artwork Variations

The game includes a wide variety of artwork variations, appearing in battle portraits, character effects, full-body illustrations, damaged versions, death screens, and more.

Costume Change System

Players can switch between unlocked character outfits in the dressing room.

Side-Scrolling Combat Gameplay

Unlike traditional visual novels, players can actively participate in combat.

Diverse Story Scenes

Dialogues and cutscenes change depending on the character’s outfit.

Multiple Endings

Yael’s final fate is determined by the player’s choices.

Unexpected Easter Eggs

What secrets are hidden in these maps?

Unique Western-Fantasy Character Design

Characters are styled differently from those in typical games.

Mostly Original Soundtrack

Includes custom-composed BGM purchased specifically for the game.

data.short_description: Eight years after the war, Yal has grown up. One day, during a playful mischief, she accidentally broke the family heirloom. Her father then decided to send her on a journey to find the materials needed for its repair. And the story I’m about to tell begins here. What will her future hold?

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2300 @ 2,80 GHz, AMD FX 8120 @ 3.1 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GT 630 / 650m, AMD Radeon HD6570 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 100% DirectX 9.0c compatible sound card
